_doc: Satmap palette (bridge/satmap-clean.mjs): one flat sRGB colour per surface + procedural noise, no game file read (Bohemia advice). Colours re-tuned 2026-11-27 on the top-down Arland satellite map (reforger.recoil.org/arland viewer, median of a box or of a pixel class, see 'src'; already satmap colours, no sunlight factor). 'hand:' entries are derived, no reference area. grain = strength of the procedural detail (0..1), scale = size of the finest detail in metres. families = fallback colour for unknown / mod surfaces, matched on the material name.

biomes._doc: Per-biome overrides, same entry format as surfaces. Key = map biome id (src/data/biomes.ts), aliases = climate ids (src/biomes/groundClasses.ts). A biome only needs an entry when the same surface name must read differently there; missing names fall back to the base palette.
